scheme_name: Kalyani Sahayata Yojana (Madhya Pradesh Labor Welfare Board)
other_conditions: The applicant must be the widow of the deceased worker
The deceased worker must have been employed in an industrial institution or establishment covered by the Madhya Pradesh Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1982 for at least one year prior to his death
The deceased worker must have been registered with the Madhya Pradesh Labour Welfare Board
The widow must not have remarried
The widow must not be receiving financial assistance from any other government department
benefits_summary: Eligible widows receive financial assistance of ₹6,000 every six months, amounting to ₹12,000 per year.
